diagram:
flowchart TD
  TRIG["⚡ Parallel to ResearchAgent"] --> SAME["🔍 Same Screener Input"]
  SAME --> DS["🤖 DeepSeek R1 LLM"]
  DS --> SIG["✍️ agent_signal\nagent_label=deepseek"]
  SIG --> COMP["📊 A/B vs Claude"]
  COMP --> LEARN["🎓 LearnerAgent P&L by model"]

TRIG.label: Parallel Trigger
TRIG.description: Runs in parallel with ResearchAgent on same symbol set. Same data, different LLM — enables A/B comparison.
TRIG.addReason: Need to know if cheaper DeepSeek produces comparable signals to Claude.

SAME.label: Same Screener Input
SAME.description: Identical screener output as ResearchAgent. Only LLM analysis differs.
SAME.addReason: Fair comparison — P&L difference must be LLM-caused, not screener-caused.

DS.label: DeepSeek R1 LLM
DS.description: DeepSeek R1 API. ~80% cheaper than Claude. Routed via lib/llm-router.ts with model='deepseek'.
DS.addReason: If signals comparable to Claude, switch primary to save ~80% LLM costs.

SIG.label: Write agent_signal
SIG.description: Writes to agent_signals with agent_label='deepseek'. Tagged for LearnerAgent comparison.
SIG.addReason: Must tag by source model to enable P&L comparison.

COMP.label: A/B Comparison
COMP.description: LearnerAgent compares win rate, avg return between Claude and DeepSeek. Results on Learning page.
COMP.addReason: Meaningful after 10+ closed trades per model. Unlocks Phase 1.

LEARN.label: LearnerAgent Tracking
LEARN.description: Sunday batch includes per-model breakdown: Claude vs DeepSeek win rates, avg returns.
LEARN.addReason: Data over time decides which model to use as primary.
